# Smart Picks Daily

> Smart Picks Daily is a US-focused guide site (for adults 18+) covering survey sites, rewards apps, cashback and everyday money-saving methods. Its promise is "We Check It First": every app, panel or offer flow is walked end to end — sign-up, terms, payout rules — before it is recommended. Some outbound links are sponsored affiliate links labelled #ad. Nothing on the site is guaranteed; readers are always told to read the terms.

## Services (what Smart Picks Daily does for readers)

- Daily Picks: a short rotating shortlist of survey sites, apps and savings offers that passed the day's checks.
- Checked Apps ("We Check It First"): apps are installed and walked; permissions, point values and cash-out thresholds are verified before listing.
- Survey Guides: plain-English walkthroughs of how survey panels work — screening, quotas and redemption rules.
- Rewards Explained: what points and credits are worth, why rates differ, and where rewards money comes from.
- Savings Playbook: everyday money-saving methods, starting with price-per-unit math.
- The 10-Minute Test: the standard trial — a new app or panel gets ten honest minutes to show a clear earning path.
- Scam Spotter: how to spot fake survey/app offers — check what the flow actually is, read the terms, run the permissions check.
- Deals Alerts (NEW): email alerts when a checked pick changes or a new guide is published.
- App of the Day (NEW): one app per day with an honest verdict on the checks it passed.
- Points-Expiry Tracker Guide (NEW): how to log balances, find expiry rules and protect points from inactivity clocks.
- Community Picks (NEW): reader-suggested offers, stress-tested and rated by how clear their terms are.

## Guides

- [How rewards online actually work, step by step](https://smartpicksdaily.onrender.com/how-rewards-online-work.html): the full loop — profile, actions, points, thresholds, redemption, and where the money comes from.
- [Before you install any app: the 10-second check](https://smartpicksdaily.onrender.com/before-you-install-app-check.html): permissions, listing signals and payout clarity checks to run before installing.
- [Why your points expire (and the 5-minute fix)](https://smartpicksdaily.onrender.com/why-points-expire.html): inactivity clocks and program changes, plus a monthly routine that protects balances.
- [Price per unit: the bag math that saves money](https://smartpicksdaily.onrender.com/price-per-unit.html): the price ÷ amount division that reveals true cost per ounce or pound.
- [Survey terms: 5 words to find first](https://smartpicksdaily.onrender.com/survey-terms-five-words.html): eligibility, quota, threshold, expiry and data — the clauses that matter.
- [Separate email for offers: the tidy-inbox system](https://smartpicksdaily.onrender.com/separate-email-for-offers.html): setting up a dedicated inbox for panels and apps.
- [Cashback apps: how it actually works](https://smartpicksdaily.onrender.com/cashback-apps-how-it-works.html): How cashback actually tracks, when it pays, and why some purchases never earn a cent.
- [How to spot a fake survey site](https://smartpicksdaily.onrender.com/how-to-spot-a-fake-survey-site.html): The red flags that mark a fake survey site — before you hand over your email or your time.
- [Gift cards vs. cash: which payout is worth more](https://smartpicksdaily.onrender.com/gift-cards-vs-cash.html): Gift cards often pay less than cash — or more. Here is how to compare payouts before you redeem.
- [Receipt-scanning apps: the honest walkthrough](https://smartpicksdaily.onrender.com/receipt-scanning-apps.html): Snap receipts, earn points: what receipt apps really pay and where the catches hide.
- [Referral programs, explained honestly](https://smartpicksdaily.onrender.com/referral-programs-explained.html): Referral bonuses explained: how they pay, what counts, and when they are worth your time.
- [When to redeem your points (and when to wait)](https://smartpicksdaily.onrender.com/when-to-redeem-points.html): Redeem now or wait? The timing rules that keep your points from losing value.
- [Why some offers are US-only](https://smartpicksdaily.onrender.com/why-offers-are-us-only.html): Geo rules explained: why offers vanish by country, how location checks work, and what to check first.
- [Store brand vs name brand: what's actually worth buying generic](https://smartpicksdaily.onrender.com/store-brand-vs-name-brand.html): Which groceries are worth buying generic, which are worth the name brand, and the unit-price check that settles it.
- [How to save money on groceries: the 15-minute weekly routine](https://smartpicksdaily.onrender.com/the-15-minute-weekly-deals-routine.html): A 15-minute weekly routine: plan before you shop, check unit prices at the store, and use what you already own.
- [Apps that pay real money: how to tell the legit ones from the scams](https://smartpicksdaily.onrender.com/apps-that-pay-real-money-legit-check.html): Green flags and red flags, realistic earnings, and payout checks to run before you spend your time.
- [How to tell if an app is safe to download: the 60-second check](https://smartpicksdaily.onrender.com/how-to-tell-if-an-app-is-safe.html): Developer identity, Data Safety, recent reviews, permissions and Play Protect — in sixty seconds.
- [Which app permissions should you turn off? The allow-or-deny guide](https://smartpicksdaily.onrender.com/permissions-audit-what-to-switch-off.html): A permission-by-permission allow-or-deny guide, with a table by app type and Permission Manager steps.
- [The pantry check that cuts your weekly bill](https://smartpicksdaily.onrender.com/the-pantry-check-that-cuts-your-weekly-bill.html): The pantry-first checklist that turns what you already own into the week's meals.

## Hubs and our method

- [Rewards guides: surveys, points and apps, checked first](https://smartpicksdaily.onrender.com/rewards-guides.html): Every rewards guide in one place — how points work, survey terms, payout rules and the checks we run first.
- [Save money on groceries and everyday spending](https://smartpicksdaily.onrender.com/savings-guides.html): Every savings guide in one place — price per unit, store brands, weekly routines, pantry checks and cashback apps.
- [Apps, checked first: safety, permissions and payouts](https://smartpicksdaily.onrender.com/apps-guides.html): Every apps guide in one place — safety checks, permissions audits, payout rules and the red flags to spot first.
- [How we check every pick](https://smartpicksdaily.onrender.com/about-how-we-check.html): Our method — what we walk, what we read, and what we never recommend, including the offer we blacklisted.

Every guide carries a descriptive hero image that illustrates its topic.
